'''Charr Ontee''' was the native [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by the [[Charr Ontee]]. [[Speaker (Yapi)|Speaker]], a [[Yapi]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]], was capable of speaking Charr Ontee and uses his knowledge to help the crew of the ''[[FarStar]]'' to communicate with the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Endgame">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Endgame (adventure)|book=Endgame|reprint=yes}}</ref>
